-- name test_zjzh
-- type Spark SQL
-- author liaiping@dwzq.com.cn
-- create time 2024-12-03 15:44:55
-- desc 
select a.branch_code,a.item_rmb AS acct_beg_num,b.item_rmb AS acct_curr_num,c.item_rmb AS acct_curr_scene_num,d.item_rmb AS acct_curr_ol_num,e.item_rmb AS acct_curr_wit_num,
 f.item_rmb AS acct_canc_curr_num,t.item_rmb AS acct_sleep_to_norm_num,g.item_rmb AS acct_total_end_num,
a.item_rmb+b.item_rmb-f.item_rmb+t.item_rmb-g.item_rmb AS diff_val,20241129 AS check_date
   from (select branch_code, sum(case 
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end) item_rmb,
             sum(case  when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end) item_sb,
             sum(case 
                              when currency_code='USD' and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='USD' and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end)  item_hb
        from rmc.dw_tb_tzjzhtj  a 
        where khflfs in(1,91,9)
             and biz_date=get_last_n_txdate(CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01'),-1)
             and branch_code='0230'
              group by branch_code
            ) a 
      left join(   --本期新开户数'
      select '本期新开户数',
              9 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC+ZJKHS_WS+ZJKHS_JZ) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_HKD+ZJKHS_WS_HKD+ZJKHS_JZ_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_USD+ZJKHS_WS_USD+ZJKHS_JZ_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC+ZJKHS_WS+ZJKHS_JZ+ZJKHS_XC_HKD+ZJKHS_WS_HKD+ZJKHS_JZ_HKD+ZJKHS_XC_USD+ZJKHS_WS_USD+ZJKHS_JZ_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129' 
              group by branch_code) b
       on a.branch_code=b.branch_code
       left join (
      SELECT '本期新开资金户数(现场)',/*本期新开户数 - 网上开户数 - 见证开户数*/
       10 SN,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC+ZJKHS_XC_HKD+ZJKHS_XC_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'   
              group by branch_code) c
       on a.branch_code=c.branch_code
      left join(
      select '本期新开资金户数(网上)',
              11 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS+ZJKHS_WS_HKD+ZJKHS_WS_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129' 
              group by branch_code )d
       on a.branch_code=d.branch_code
      left join(
      select '本期新开资金户数(见证)',
              12 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ+ZJKHS_JZ_HKD+ZJKHS_JZ_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'  
              group by branch_code
) e
       on a.branch_code=e.branch_code
      left join(
      select '本期销户数',
              13 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC+ZJXHS_WS+ZJXHS_JZ) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC_HKD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC_USD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC+ZJXHS_WS+ZJXHS_JZ+ZJXHS_XC_HKD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_HKD+ZJXHS_XC_USD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'  
              group by branch_code)f
       on a.branch_code=f.branch_code
     left join(
     SELECT '本期休眠账户数转正常账户数' ,
        14 SN ,branch_code,
       /*T.GDJHBZ*/ XMJHS item_rmb,
       0 AS ITEM_SB,
       0 AS ITEM_HB,
       /*T.GDJHBZ*/ XMJHS AS HJ,
       0 AS ITEM_SB_RMB,
       0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
  FROM (
          SELECT branch_code,SUM(XMJHS) XMJHS
             FROM base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033 
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'  group by branch_code ) 
             )T  
       on a.branch_code=t.branch_code
     left join (
        select '客户帐户期末合计户数',
              18 sn,branch_code,
              item_rmb,
              item_sb,
              item_hb,
              item_rmb+item_sb+item_hb hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from (select branch_code, sum(case 
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end) item_rmb,
             sum(case 
                              when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end)
             item_sb,
             sum(case 
                              when currency_code='USD'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='USD'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end)
             item_hb
        from rmc.dw_tb_tzjzhtj  a 
        where khflfs in(1,91,9)
            and biz_date= '20241129'
            and branch_code='0230'
            group by branch_code
            ) b
            ) g
       on a.branch_code=g.branch_code
